notes.title: Small Update + Big News!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone! We've managed to do a small update just adding in new Patrons to the title screen of the game to show appreciation for those who support us. You can find their social media / channel links under "Crankage Games" as you load the game.

Also, we'd like to announce that we've added in a new tier to Patreon where fans all around the world can become a character in The Chronicles of Quiver Dick! More info in the Patreon link itself.

Now, as for the BIG news...
We will be rolling out a FREE content update in the near future! It will add in an entirely new level, various boss updates, new items, new bosses, and new NPCs with brand new dialogue to show support for those who have supported us along the way!

We see the feedback. We read those reviews from fans that have taken the time to show support across all 6 of our releases and helped to push us out there and make our dreams a reality. We want to show you just as much appreciation as you've shown us! We will be adding in new characters with familiar names, (Maybe even your own.) with lots of new stuff to interact with!

While the game is done as is, it doesn't mean we can't continue to add to it and improve, right? Let's keep this growing!

Thank you all so very much for your support! If you'd like to support us further or get in touch with us, you can do so on Patreon and Twitter below!

- Crankage Games [/b]

https://www.patreon.com/CrankageGames
https://twitter.com/CrankageGames

notes.title: Big Update! The Chronicles of Quiver D!ck!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone!

So, as far as this update goes, I won't say a lot about it because let's face it... Patch notes can be rather boring, especially when it comes to the technical inner-workings of the system.

However, what I will say is this:

[list]
 [*]New NPC's have been added.
 [*]New Gear has been added.
 [*]Returning Cameo's from Metal as Phu.k have been added.
 [*]Bosses have been modified. (Internally and slightly)
 [*]Certain events in the game have been modified to provide the average player with up to 20% more content overall.
(Some of it is blatant and some of it is hidden, waiting to be found!)
 [*]+ Some other stuff that I'm totally forgetting... but it's there! [/list]

We hope you enjoy your time playing the game and we're ALWAYS looking to improve wherever possible! We'd love to hear your feedback and we always read reviews and comments! Thank you so much and I hope you have a wonderful day!

- Crankage Games 	[/b]

notes.title: Small Update! New Additions!
notes.notes:
[b]We're pleased to see that nothing major or game-breaking has been reported, as we put a lot of time and effort into testing before releasing.

With that being said, we did see a few things that we feel may add a bit more balance to the overall feel of the game so we're putting in another minor update:

 [list]
    [*]Bonus Content Added! New NPC's Based on Supporters of Metal as 
       Phu.k and The Chronicles of Quiver D!ck Added to the game!
    [*]Grimmsby Boss Fight Damage Slightly Increased, Health Decreased
    [*]Doomwalker Boss Health Slightly Decreased
    [*]Dominatrix JoJo Boss Health Slightly Decreased
    [*]Krendler Boss Fight Damage Slightly Increased
    [*]Cock-Ness Monster Boss Fight Damage Slightly Increased
    [*]Minor Dialogue Fixes Implemented
    [*]New Events Added for Bonus Items and Experience
    [*]Gandank Greysmoke Boss Fight Damage Slightly Increased
    [*]Some Minor Additions have been made to add more polish to events!
[/list]

Most of these changes are quality of life changes, but some of them, such as the new additions to NPC's being added into the game is our way of showing our support for YOU, the players! Thank you SO very much for everything you do! We're currently adding to this project as well as working on multiple new projects, so keep an eye out!

Thank you all very much for playing The Chronicles of Quiver Dick and we hope you enjoy your time spent! As always, we'd love to hear your feedback in the reviews below and we wish you all a fantastic day!

- Crankage Games 	[/b]

notes.title: Update - Small Patch!
notes.notes:
[b]We're pleased to see that nothing major or game-breaking has been reported, as we put a lot of time and effort into testing before releasing.

With that being said, we did see a few things that we feel may add a bit more balance to the overall feel of the game so we're putting in a minor update:

 [list]
    [*]Potion Healing Increased from 250 to 350. (Potion Buy Price increased slightly to compensate.)
    [*]Magic Water MP Gain increased from 75 to 100. (Magic Water Buy Price increased slightly to compensate.)
    [*]Rejuvenation Elixir Buy Price slightly decreased.
    [*]Tasty Apple Buy Price slightly decreased.
    [*]Charred Fish Sell Price Increased from 100 to 200.
    [*]Solid Gold Fishing Rod Sell Price increased from 250 to 500.
    [*]Pure Golden Fish Sell Price increased from 500 to 1000.
    [*]Slight Text Overlap on one NPC has been fixed.
    [*]Dominatrix JoJo Boss fight has been slightly buffed.
    [*]The Bandits Boss fight has been slightly buffed.
    [*]Gandank Greysmoke Boss fight has been slightly buffed.
    [*]Richard Longshlong's Missile Barrage has been significantly buffed.
    [*]Starting gold has been increased from 50 to 100.
[/list]

Most of these changes are quality of life changes, but some of them, such as the boss fights being buffed, are a direct result of undertuned abilities not working as intended. Overall, you shouldn't notice TOO much of a difference in difficulty but battles listed above should flow more smoothly now.

This is a very minor patch that didn't NEED to be put in, but we felt that if there's anything we can improve in the time we're given, then we should aim to improve whenever possible.

Thank you all very much for playing The Chronicles of Quiver Dick and we hope you enjoy your time spent! As always, we'd love to hear your feedback in the reviews below and we wish you all a fantastic day!

- Crankage Games 	[/b]
